officialLinks.label: Grades, GPA formula, excluded notations, standing, SAP

helpIntro: WashU uses a 4.0 undergraduate GPA scale. Enter credit units and final grades; A and A+ are both 4.0, and F counts as 0.0.
helpNote: For the traditional undergraduate record. Pass/No Pass, transfer credit, unresolved I/N, withdrawals and audits are excluded. Law uses a different grading system. The Repeat Impact tool is disabled because the shared estimator cannot safely model WashU's higher-attempt rule.
helpExample: A 3-unit A earns 12.0 grade points and a 4-unit B earns 12.0. Together, 24.0 ÷ 7 = 3.429.

gradeExplanations.I: Incomplete; excluded while unresolved and may convert to F after the university deadline.
gradeExplanations.N: No grade reported; excluded while unresolved and may convert to F after the university deadline.
gradeExplanations.R: Retaken-course notation; the lower attempt is excluded from GPA under the standard undergraduate retake policy.

specialTypes.name: WashU course, standard grading
specialTypes.note: Enter the final WashU letter grade and credit units.

specialTypes.name: External transfer credit
specialTypes.note: Transfer grades do not enter the WashU GPA.

specialTypes.name: Retaken attempt marked R
specialTypes.note: Use for the lower attempt that is excluded after an eligible undergraduate retake.

specialTypes.name: WashU Law course/record
specialTypes.note: WashU Law uses a different numerical grading system; do not apply the undergraduate 4.0 scale.

repeatPolicy.note: For an eligible undergraduate retake, count the higher attempt and mark the lower attempt as Retaken attempt marked R. Confirm eligibility with your school.
